reflection_rows.reflection: The phase is stronger when watchers supervise the lanes and Aletheon uses wait windows for source, reflection, and build prep.

reflection_rows.theme: Substantial output is not always harvestable output
reflection_rows.reflection: Aster produced a substantial artifact, but exact heading gaps made it unharvestable by the quality gate.
reflection_rows.x2_build_priority: Add repair-state transitions that distinguish format repair from content failure.

reflection_rows.reflection: The exact heading contract is now part of the CLI platform, not just a style preference.
reflection_rows.x2_build_priority: Treat prompt dry-runs and heading checks as preflight requirements.

reflection_rows.theme: Source research must become build constraints
reflection_rows.reflection: Codex, MCP, OWASP, OpenTelemetry, ADK, NVIDIA, and GitHub sources all point toward explicit control points, telemetry, guardrails, and provenance.
reflection_rows.x2_build_priority: Attach source references to build matrix rows.

reflection_rows.theme: No-overclaim is a recurring safety rail
reflection_rows.reflection: Every phase artifact should preserve GMUT/physics/consciousness/canon openness unless exact evidence changes that state.
reflection_rows.x2_build_priority: Keep claim_boundary fields required in boards, ledgers, and closeouts.

reflection_rows.reflection: Skill ideas can be planned and labeled without mutating live user skills or plugin caches.
reflection_rows.x2_build_priority: Build from the overlay registry before requesting live skill mutation.

reflection_rows.reflection: Each helper now has a known role and x2 requirement, which reduces guessing during long runs.
reflection_rows.x2_build_priority: Use the compatibility map as the runner upgrade checklist.

reflection_rows.theme: Publication discipline is part of THOS
reflection_rows.reflection: Parse, scan, fetch, exact-stage, whitespace-check, commit, push, and remote-verify are not bureaucracy; they are the operating system's trust fabric.
reflection_rows.x2_build_priority: Generate provenance receipts for consolidated x2 packets.

reflection_rows.theme: App lanes and CLI lanes need one board
reflection_rows.reflection: The council is operationally clearer when app and CLI lanes share one status grammar.

reflection_rows.theme: The x2 phase should build, not just summarize
